scope: PR #175 PR-B (11 files): the step-3 plan mode in check-task-plan.mjs (SKILL_TO_RECORD + validateRecord per record type + validateAdr), the ESK_PLANS wiring in edit-gate.mjs, 16 scenarios + the step defs (runFinish extended to run plan), ADR-0099, 11 plan tests + a step-3 edit-gate deny, CHANGELOG. The reviewer found the four questions clean and no false-pass path in the plan mode (evid accepts only observed/proven; threat/control/scenario and empty arrays rejected; a not-applicable skill does not require its record; malformed input fails closed); it raised two medium findings, both fixed before this entry.

boundary.evidence: the plan mode is one more mode of the existing validator; SKILL_TO_RECORD and the validateRecord schema table each live once.

ownership.evidence: one owner of the skill-to-record map and the schemas; the edit-gate does not duplicate them.

dependency.evidence: Node built-ins only; the ADR is a structural pre-check, not a shell-out to bash (check_adr stays the deep gate), so the plan check and the BDD run stay off bash. grep found only the word 'document' in a comment.

error-handling.evidence: every missing/incomplete record and all malformed input route to hold (exit 2); no path reads as exit 0. evid() accepts only observed/proven (object-typed). F1 fix: validateAdr now accepts a heading-style Status and either Considered Options (MADR) or a Decision section (Nygard), so a valid Nygard ADR (incl the repo's own 0001) is no longer false-rejected. N2 fix: the dead safeToShip guard removed (the observed/proven requirement already forbids safe-to-ship below observed).

boundary.evidence: step 3 runs after select + load; a source edit is held on a plan hold.

error-handling.evidence: ESK_PLANS set + plan hold -> deny (exit 2); unset -> disclosed allow (not a silent skip); the PR-A whole-handler try/catch + uncaughtException + stdin error -> deny still hold.

boundary.evidence: integration tests spawning the real validator and gate.

error-handling.evidence: F2 fix: added a negative test per previously-unguarded branch (bdd-matrix no audiences / bad cell, service-readiness no alertFires / no runbook, browser-verdict below observed, usability-verdict no claim, data-lifecycle no dataClass, arch-standards no claims, empty threats, ADR no-status / no-options / missing-file) plus a Nygard-accepted regression; a surgical no-op of any branch now flips a test. 36 plan-related tests pass.

boundary.evidence: 16 scenarios (one @audience:operator) under the Step-3 rule drive the real validator; ADR-0099 records the decision and limits.

ownership.evidence: runFinish (shared select->load->plan) extended once; PR-A behavior preserved (silent-skip fails at selection, applies-but-not-loaded at load).

error-handling.evidence: negative scenarios hold at exit 2; the happy scenarios assert status 0 across Then lines (individually vacuous but the plan check genuinely ran, and the negatives + unit tests discriminate). N1 noted in ADR-0099: cited measurement/@security-scenario names are not existence-checked here (owning gates + review cover them).

findings.finding: proven against live data: validateAdr false-rejected valid Nygard-format ADRs (incl the committed docs/adr/0001) because it required a frontmatter 'status:' and a 'Considered Options' section, while the ADR skill explicitly produces Nygard lightweight ADRs. It held in the safe direction but blocked legitimate work with a misleading message.
findings.resolution: fixed: accept a heading-style Status (`^#+ status`) or a frontmatter 'status:', and accept either 'Considered Options' (MADR) or a Decision section (Nygard). Regression test added (a Nygard ADR is accepted; a truly status-less or options-and-decision-less ADR is still refused).

findings.finding: a full no-op validator was caught, but several branches (bdd-matrix, service-readiness, browser/usability verdicts, data-lifecycle fields, arch-standards fields, empty threats, ADR section checks) had no discriminating test, so a surgical no-op could pass with a green suite - the false-green verifiable-quality-gates forbids.
findings.resolution: fixed: added a negative test for each previously-unguarded branch (13 new plan tests), so a surgical no-op of any branch now flips a test.
